title.zh: Russia to ban direct peer-to-peer crypto trades starting July 2027
title.en: Russia to ban direct peer-to-peer crypto trades starting July 2027

current_state.zh: The Bank of Russia said direct peer-to-peer crypto transactions between individuals will be prohibited from July 1, 2027, requiring trades via authorized intermediaries, and clarified that transfers from digital accounts to self-custodial wallets are not allowed.
current_state.en: The Bank of Russia said direct peer-to-peer crypto transactions between individuals will be prohibited from July 1, 2027, requiring trades via authorized intermediaries, and clarified that transfers from digital accounts to self-custodial wallets are not allowed.
